remarks: Have you been seeking a fabulously spacious and amenity-rich rental only steps from Downtown Stamford? Situated in the popular high-rise building of Haye House Condominiums, this 3BR/2BA rental condo affords an advantageous lifestyle of both convenience & style. Lovingly maintained, the sizeable urban residence features an openly flowing traditional layout, ample natural light, beautiful parquet floors, elegant crown molding, and a living room with direct access to the blissfully private balcony. Explore the galley kitchen to find stainless-steel appliances, granite countertops, white cabinets, and a dining area. Fashioned for comfort, the primary bedroom impresses with a walk-in closet and an en-suite featuring a step-in shower and a storage vanity. Both extra bedrooms are perfectly appointed for flexible uses, while the full hallway bathroom satisfies multigenerational needs with a shower/tub combo. *Heat, Hot Water & A/C Included* Catering to discerning desires, the community includes access to amenities, such as a fitness/health center, courtyard with grills, private storage locker, community room, community laundry, 24-hour security, on-site superintendent, concierge, and bike storage. Other features: secure garage parking, guest parking, close to Metro North to NYC, I-95, parks, shopping, beach, restaurants, medical facilities, entertainment, bars, schools, Target, & public transit, & more! Come see today, and become part of one of Stamford's most coveted communities!
